qa_pairs.question: What is the system identification number for this START circuit diagram?
What fuse rating is shown for Fuse 10 in the power distribution box?
According to the note about unloader relay coils, when are they grounded through the starting motor?
qa_pairs.answer: Unloader relay coils are grounded through starting motor except when starting. When starting, battery voltage is applied to both sides of unloader relay coils and relays are de-energized.
